presentationTable.name: Dimensions - Customer

presentationColumns.name: Customer Code
presentationColumns.description: Business-facing customer identifier for customer-level analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Home Country
presentationColumns.description: Customer home country used for geographic and market analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Age Band
presentationColumns.description: Customer age range used for demographic segmentation.

presentationColumns.name: Gender Affinity
presentationColumns.description: Fashion affinity segment used for customer analysis; not a legal or identity attribute.

presentationColumns.name: Loyalty Tier
presentationColumns.description: Customer loyalty tier, useful for comparing behavior across loyalty segments.

presentationColumns.name: Acquisition Channel
presentationColumns.description: Channel through which the customer was acquired.

presentationColumns.name: Signup Date
presentationColumns.description: Date when the customer joined or became known to the business.

presentationColumns.name: Discount Sensitivity
presentationColumns.description: Relative indicator of how responsive the customer is to discounts and promotions.

presentationColumns.name: Style Affinity
presentationColumns.description: Primary style preference segment inferred for the customer.

presentationColumns.name: Is Active
presentationColumns.description: Flags customers considered active in the synthetic customer base.

presentationTable.description: Core customer dimension for customer segment, loyalty, acquisition, and style-affinity analysis.
